dates.text: anno à Notuvu Domini millesimoquadringentesimo quadragesimo primo

data.summary: Felix V grants a special dispensation to Andreas Perolerius, a cleric of the Diocese of Tournai, to receive the parish church of Saint Julian in Berriacum, which is being resigned by its rector Petrus Perolerius, despite Andreas being under the canonical age of 25.
